hypotheses: If auxiliary sampling changes later main-stream draws, restoring Python/NumPy/Torch RNG after the same auxiliary update will recover the IPPO continuation RNG.
If extra zero-gradient residual parameters alter clipping arithmetic, common gradients may match before clipping but differ afterward despite matched RNG.
If PPO itself follows a different update path, differences will appear before the auxiliary call; record that boundary explicitly.
limits: Fresh initialization and one 4,000-transition native batch, not a replay of the completed 3M policy or a return experiment.
RNG restoration is a diagnostic intervention, not an independently seeded auxiliary stream or a promoted implementation.
A same-seed comparison with different RNG consumption is still a valid independent run; it is not an exact no-input equivalence test.
